accepted_decisions.claim: The Term system primitive relations are SUBTYPE_OF, IS_BORNE_BY, and IS_ALLOWED_VALUE_OF; BEARS is the derived inverse of IS_BORNE_BY.
A slash serializes one bearer edge and a colon serializes assignment of an allowed value; a value-qualified Entity may bear another Property.
INSTANCE_OF and every other graph relation remain graph-specific and outside the Term-system primitive registry.
SUBTYPE_OF is an acyclic open multiple-inheritance graph; all compatible parent invariants apply conjunctively and an inherited conflict invalidates the subtype.
Every governed Term and Subject Expression segment starts with a capital letter, while registered CCE operators remain lowercase and bold.
No Entity name contains a slash, and no governed Term or Scope Unit name equals a registered CCE operator.
Entity is not Artifact; Artifact and Actor are Base Entities, Property is a Dependent Entity, and every Entity may bear zero or more Properties.
Atom, Journal, Projection, and Relational Artifact are Artifact subtypes; Relational Atom is an Atom subtype; Scope Unit and Epic are Relational Artifact subtypes.
Relational Atom and Relational Artifact remain distinct; Scope Unit and Epic are not Atoms.
Every Property occurrence has exactly one immediate bearer, but a reusable Term has no global ordinal-position invariant.
Every Atom has exactly one independently replaceable Claim and exactly one atomic or composite Claim Scope.
Logical or set composition alone does not create multiple Claims or Claim Scopes; independent replaceability is the split test.
Summary is a non-authoritative navigation Projection derived from the complete Claim and Claim Scope and has no independent identity, lifecycle, or authority.
Subjects are independent Entities referenced by Claim-Subject relations rather than descendants of Atom, Claim, or Artifact.
Every Claim-Subject relation has exactly one Kind in GOVERNS or DEPENDS_ON and exactly one Temporal Form in CONTINUANT or OCCURRENT.
Every Atom has one or two GOVERNS relations, with at most one per Temporal Form; DEPENDS_ON has no such cardinality limit.
Content Role is an Atom Property whose allowed values are Concern, Analysis, Plan, Requirement, Method, Evaluation, Delivery, Implementation, and Operations.
Type is borne by a value-qualified Content Role; Task is a Plan Type, and Job and Demand are distinct Requirement Types.
Core default Concern Types are Question, Conflict, and Problem; Core default Analysis Types are Analysis Report and Rationale.
Local Tier is a separate Atom Property with Principle, Core, and Standard; Standard is the default and omits its filename token.
Current Scope and Claim Scope are references; an empty Current Scope resolves to its identified Operator.
Only an accepted Job Atom may establish a Scope Unit; its admission and Scope Unit establishment are atomic.
The direct parent owns the establishing Job for a child Scope Unit; the Operator owns the Project-root exception; the same pattern applies recursively.
A Demand is owned by its Consumer and constrains only the Producer result on which the Consumer Job depends; it does not define Producer scope.
Demand direction derives from Consumer Current Scope and Producer Claim Scope references and introduces no additional relation kind.
Demands to ancestors, descendants, direct children, and later ordered siblings are forbidden.
Epic is a recursive folder-carried Relational Artifact; Task is Atom/Content Role: Plan/Type: Task and may be standalone.
Epic membership uses only Delivery-derived CONTAINS and IS_CONTAINED_BY; Task Job is redundant with the Task Claim.
Every Task has exactly one effective Author, Assignee, and Autonomous Confidence Threshold; Author defaults to Operator and Assignee to AI Agent.
Status is resolved from the complete Entity-Type context; RMED Core values are Draft, Active, and Archived, while Task Core values are Draft, Active, Done, and Canceled.
Active uses the current Carrier folder; any other Status uses the corresponding status subfolder; prior transitions belong in the Journal.
Methodology Source is the target role of DERIVED_FROM from an Applicable Methodology Revision to an exact Artifact Revision.
Applicable Methodology is both Projection and Relational Artifact and selects current active RMEDO source Atom Revisions without synthesizing Claims.
Current compilation uses Core Meta-Model and Local Configuration; Installed Extensions remain optional until active.
Unresolved compilation conflicts fail closed until exact digest-bound Operator approval is recorded in source authority.
Every Carrier-specific Claim has Content Role Delivery; Carrier is a Base Entity classified by Delivery authority.
CARRIES and IS_CARRIED_BY explicitly relate Carrier and Artifact Revision in opposite directions.
Every represented folder is a Directory Carrier for one Relational Artifact; CONTAINS and IS_CONTAINED_BY derive only from canonical Carrier nesting and are never persisted separately.
File, directory, database, frontmatter, main content, filename, folder, Journal, Status placement, and projected-file materialization rules belong exclusively to Delivery.
Concrete CAPRMEDIO folder names are Project Delivery authority rather than Methodology authority.
CORE_META_MODEL, LOCAL_CONFIGURATION, and Extension Scope Units are named instances rather than Scope Unit subtypes.
